scope: Only the four enumerated adapter/helper/test files. No production dispatch, native writer, builder, material exporter, dependency or license edits.
verification: Tree-sitter C# source parse, pinned API review, declaration hashes and git diff --check. No SDK/compiler/test/corpus invocation.

variables.F: sum of vertex count times maximum influence width per primitive
variables.Q/q: total geometry-array elements copied by DeepClone across all occurrences / one primitive; includes optional bind-pose and bitangent arrays

findings: Legacy GlbWriter emits each skin through AddSkinnedMesh with its own joint/inverse-bind tuples and ignores the optional part.NodeIndex on that branch.
Existing NifExportSceneBuilder successful skin branch omits NodeIndex; generated neutral placements admit this production-shaped input without inventing source-node identity.
Rigid grouping remains by sorted original owner index. Every skin occurrence receives its own mesh, palette and identity-transform placement after the unchanged original node prefix.
Source ordinal provenance disambiguates duplicate names, repeated object references and filtered occurrences.
Geometry normalization uses existing DeepClone and winding implementation, preserving caller-owned arrays.
Shared evaluator applies inverse-bind times joint-world for skin deformation; generated node identity transforms avoid extra mesh-owner placement.
Corpus assertions retain triangle and normal checks and now verify exact source prefix, original child edges, every extra skin occurrence, palette/binds, and source metadata.
Real-corpus class now uses Collection(SequentialIntegrationGroup.Name), as required by CLAUDE.md, without changing its existing callable bodies or geometry assertions.

One additional synthetic case asserts a hierarchical noncommuting transform against fixed converted world position (8,30,-21) using actual parent/child AddNode calls and native/shared serialized GLB output.
generated_members: NifNeutralSkinPlacement record primary constructor and equality/accessors are compiler-generated; its authored positional signature stores four fixed-size fields/references with O(1) work/storage.
limitations: No compiler or runtime validation per assigned scope.
Private NIF corpus is not present/read; corpus gate remains pending.
No production legacy-to-shared dispatch replacement or rendering parity acceptance is claimed.
Animated-pose behavior and private skinned-model acceptance remain open; no synthetic or corpus execution is claimed.

hash_identity_note: Per-file sha256 identifies the exact measured working-file bytes. sha256_lf identifies the same text bytes with CRLF replaced by LF. git_filtered_blob_sha1 is the Git blob SHA-1 returned by git hash-object -- <relative path>, with repository clean filters/attributes applied and without -w or an object write. The LF and filtered Git identities support verification across normal LF/CRLF checkouts; the working-byte hash remains unchanged as historical evidence. Callable declaration_sha256_lf likewise normalizes CRLF to LF.
